1.​ Authenticity rules Belt Flag

     1.1.​ Definition and general requirements
       ●​ A competitor must have a belt flag with your number on it that identifies you
       ●​ A competitor may have a second belt flag that is decorative symbols and decorations used for this
           must be based on historical sources. Any clearly modern symbol or decoration is denied.
       ●​ No more than two belt flags may be worn by a competitor
                   Examples: Warhammer logo, movies or TV show imagery, modern slogan etc
      ●​ Belt flag is an element hung on a belt designed to show your belt number in the list.
      ●​ Belt flag must be made of fabric or leather.
      ●​ Belt flag must conform with the Textiles and Leather rules document.
      ●​ Belt flag consists of a base and a number.
      ●​ Base must respect the following requirements:
               ○​Base shape can be square, rectangular or triangular.
               ○​Base must have a trim to be worn with a belt.
               ○​Base must be made of one main color.
               ○​Some decoration can be added on the edges of the base.
               ○​Such decoration must not interfere with the readability of the belt flag.
       ●​ Number must respect the following requirements:
               ○​Individual figures must be from 0 to 9.
               ○​Numbers must be from 01 to 99.
               ○​Number must be written in Arabic numerals.
               ○​Number must be 13 cm tall as a minimum.
               ○​Number can be of any color, contrasting with the base main color.
       ●​ All Belt flags must respect the following dimensions:
               ○​Length: from 26 cm to 36 cm.
               ○​Width: from 14 cm to 18 cm.
